claim: Subproblem B is a schema-adequacy failure, not a model-capability or prompt-formatting failure. When the plan schema has a typed deferral slot, the model uses it 12/12 times and produces 0 failures. When the schema has only a string slot, the model invents pseudo-deferral syntax (`{'$ref': 's1'}`, `{'deferred': 'r1'}`, `$.steps[0].output`) that the executor cannot parse, and fails 12/12.

conditions.string_baseline: string-only schema (content: str), no value injected
conditions.typed_holes: schema: content: str | {__deferred__: {from, field}}, no value injected
conditions.typed_holes_oracle: schema with typed holes, seed.txt contents injected

reading: The typed-hole schema closes the class at 0/12. The string-only schema fails 12/12 even with the value injected, because the model has no legal way to express deferral — so it invents pseudo-syntax the executor cannot resolve. The failure is not in the model. It is in the plan format.

proposed_algorithm.name: Provenance-Typed Executor (PTE)
proposed_algorithm.schema_extension: content: str | DeferredValue, where DeferredValue = {__deferred__: {from: step_id, field: field_name}}
proposed_algorithm.static_validation: DeferredValue.from must reference a prior step whose tool produces that field
proposed_algorithm.runtime_resolution: DeferredValue resolves to the actual runtime observation of the referenced step; unresolved = hard error, not silent bad write
what_remains: static provenance check (zero LLM calls, deterministic)

relationship_to_H007.H007_oracle: manual runtime resolution (inject resolved value) -> 0/12 fail
relationship_to_H007.H009_typed_holes: schema-level resolution (executor resolves at execution) -> 0/12 fail
relationship_to_H007.unifying_principle: Any deferral channel the executor can resolve closes the class. Neither prohibition nor value injection is necessary; only a resolvable channel is sufficient.

paper_impact: Reframes sec 4.2-4.3: the failure is interface design, not model limitation. Rule 9 is not 'ineffective' — it is doomed by design. The contribution becomes a schema principle, not a prompt-rule critique.
